ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across 90% of the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized mottling and peripheral clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Dense, fine-grained high-intensity (white) mottling concentrated in the lower-central region and scattered sparsely toward the trailing edges. Discrete, high-contrast white circular clusters located on the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees; deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged indentations (large-scale pixel voids) present on the medial trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to sharp convex points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of 6-8 high-contrast circular pixel rosettes on the superior tip of the left lobe; smaller, similar clusters on the distal right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the interior ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jagged notch on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy localized barnacle colonization on the left lobe apex.
